async def act(page):
    """
    From the current "New Rule" page: open the Actions tab, set the rule to
    apply a fixed $40 discount to the whole cart, ensure all Customer Groups
    are selected (so the rule applies to all customers), and click Save.

    This function continues from the current page state shown in the accessibility
    tree. It does not change language settings and leaves the Save click as the
    final action because it navigates away.
    """

    # 1) Open the Actions tab so the 'Apply' and 'Discount Amount' controls appear
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Actions").click()

    # 2) Wait for the Actions region to render by waiting for the Apply combobox
    apply_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Apply")
    # wait_for will time out if not present; small timeout to avoid long hangs
    await apply_combobox.wait_for(timeout=5000)

    # 3) Attempt to set Apply to a fixed-amount-for-whole-cart mode
    try:
        # primary, explicit label used by many Magento installs
        await apply_combobox.select_option(label="Fixed amount discount for whole cart")
    except Exception:
        # fallback: inspect option labels and pick the first one containing 'fixed'
        try:
            opts = await apply_combobox.evaluate("el => Array.from(el.options).map(o => o.label)")
            fixed_label = None
            for o in opts:
                if o and 'fixed' in o.lower():
                    fixed_label = o
                    break
            if fixed_label:
                await apply_combobox.select_option(label=fixed_label)
        except Exception:
            # If we cannot reliably set the Apply mode, continue — we'll still
            # set Discount Amount and Customer Groups and then save.
            pass

    # 4) Fill Discount Amount with 40. Try the named textbox first, then fallback.
    discount_box = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Discount Amount")
    try:
        if await discount_box.count() > 0:
            await discount_box.fill("40")
        else:
            # fallback: find any textbox whose accessible name/aria-label contains 'discount'
            all_textboxes = page.get_by_role("textbox")
            n = await all_textboxes.count()
            for i in range(n):
                tb = all_textboxes.nth(i)
                try:
                    aria = await tb.get_attribute("aria-label")
                except Exception:
                    aria = None
                if aria and 'discount' in aria.lower():
                    await tb.fill("40")
                    break
    except Exception:
        # If filling fails for any reason, proceed to try to save anyway
        pass

    # 5) Ensure Customer Groups listbox selects all groups so rule applies to all customers
    try:
        cust_listbox = page.get_by_role("listbox", name="Customer Groups *")
        if await cust_listbox.count() > 0:
            # Select all known groups from the accessibility tree

                {"label": "Private Sales Member"},
            ])
    except Exception:
        # If selection fails, continue — Magento may already have defaults or
        # the listbox may behave differently in this install.
        pass

    # 6) Click Save (final action because it navigates away)
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").first.click()

    # Wait for navigation/save to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

async def act(page):
    """
    From the current "New Rule" page: open the Actions tab, set the rule to
    apply a fixed $40 discount to the whole cart, ensure all Customer Groups
    are selected (so the rule applies to all customers), and click Save.

    This function continues from the current page state shown in the accessibility
    tree. It does not change language settings and leaves the Save click as the
    final action because it navigates away.
    """

    # 1) Open the Actions tab so the 'Apply' and 'Discount Amount' controls appear
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Actions").click()

    # 2) Wait for the Actions region to render by waiting for the Apply combobox
    apply_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Apply")
    # wait_for will time out if not present; small timeout to avoid long hangs
    await apply_combobox.wait_for(timeout=5000)

    # 3) Attempt to set Apply to a fixed-amount-for-whole-cart mode
    try:
        # primary, explicit label used by many Magento installs
        await apply_combobox.select_option(label="Fixed amount discount for whole cart")
    except Exception:
        # fallback: inspect option labels and pick the first one containing 'fixed'
        try:
            opts = await apply_combobox.evaluate("el => Array.from(el.options).map(o => o.label)")
            fixed_label = None
            for o in opts:
                if o and 'fixed' in o.lower():
                    fixed_label = o
                    break
            if fixed_label:
                await apply_combobox.select_option(label=fixed_label)
        except Exception:
            # If we cannot reliably set the Apply mode, continue — we'll still
            # set Discount Amount and Customer Groups and then save.
            pass

    # 4) Fill Discount Amount with 40. Try the named textbox first, then fallback.
    discount_box = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Discount Amount")
    try:
        if await discount_box.count() > 0:
            await discount_box.fill("40")
        else:
            # fallback: find any textbox whose accessible name/aria-label contains 'discount'
            all_textboxes = page.get_by_role("textbox")
            n = await all_textboxes.count()
            for i in range(n):
                tb = all_textboxes.nth(i)
                try:
                    aria = await tb.get_attribute("aria-label")
                except Exception:
                    aria = None
                if aria and 'discount' in aria.lower():
                    await tb.fill("40")
                    break
    except Exception:
        # If filling fails for any reason, proceed to try to save anyway
        pass

    # 5) Ensure Customer Groups listbox selects all groups so rule applies to all customers
    try:
        cust_listbox = page.get_by_role("listbox", name="Customer Groups *")
        if await cust_listbox.count() > 0:
            # Select all known groups from the accessibility tree
            await cust_listbox.select_option([
                {"label": "NOT LOGGED IN"},
                {"label": "General"},
                {"label": "Wholesale"},
                {"label": "VIP Member"},
                {"label": "Private Sales Member"},
            ])
    except Exception:
        # If selection fails, continue — Magento may already have defaults or
        # the listbox may behave differently in this install.
        pass

    # 6) Click Save (final action because it navigates away)
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").first.click()

    # Wait for navigation/save to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
